common.notConfigured: The app is not connected to a Supabase project yet. Fill in the values in .env.local.
common.saveFailed: That did not work. Please try again.

auth.title: Welcome
auth.subtitle: Sign in with your email address. We send you a sign-in link – no password needed.
auth.checkInbox: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this device.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.passwordSubtitle: Sign in with email and password when your inbox is out of reach.
auth.noPasswordHint: No password yet? Sign in with a link and set one in your profile.

error.generic: Signing in did not work. Please try again.
error.linkExpired: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
error.wrongPassword: Email address or password does not match.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
error.emailNotConfirmed: This address is not confirmed yet. Open the link in your inbox first.

onboarding.choosePath: How would you like to start?
onboarding.hasInviteHint: Invitation link or QR code from your club
onboarding.joinClubHint: Send a request – the board approves it
onboarding.clubKindQuestion: What kind of club are you?
onboarding.clubKindHint: This only picks the templates – everything stays changeable.
onboarding.clubNameHint: The name everyone knows you by.
onboarding.seasonStartQuestion: When does your club year start?
onboarding.seasonStartHint: Point totals and leaderboards follow this date.
onboarding.seasonStartFootnote: The suggestion matches your kind of club and can be changed any time.
onboarding.clubSlugHint: The club tells you its short name. There is deliberately no directory of clubs.
onboarding.clubFoundHint: Is that the one? Then you can send your request.
onboarding.clubNotFound: No club with that short name. Ask the club for the exact spelling.
onboarding.requestPendingHint: You will get a message as soon as the board has decided.
onboarding.withdrawConfirm: The request will be withdrawn. You can send a new one at any time.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.nextPointsHint: Here is how you earn your next points

marketplace.title: Tasks
marketplace.subtitle: Tasks your club needs help with

leaderboard.title: Rankings
leaderboard.optOutNotice: You do not appear in the ranking. You can change this in your profile.
leaderboard.empty: No points in this season yet

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.declineReasonHint: The reason helps the organisers plan. It stays with the event and is not analysed.
agenda.declineEarly: You are cancelling in good time – that counts towards your reliability.
agenda.declineLate: The event starts soon. Declining never costs points.
agenda.declinedWithPoints: Decline saved – {{points}} points for cancelling in good time

profile.title: Profile
profile.spiderHint: Your view of yourself – only you see this analysis.
profile.deleteAccountHint: Permanently deletes your account and personal data.
profile.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. You can then sign in without a link.
profile.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in this club’s lists and leaderboards.
profile.contactHint: What you hide is not delivered to other members at all – not merely hidden. These choices apply per club.

clubSettings.title: Club settings
clubSettings.adminOnly: Only the committee can edit the club.
clubSettings.name: Club name
clubSettings.seasonStartHint: Decides which season the points count towards. Currently: {{season}}. Without a date the calendar year applies.
clubSettings.themeHint: Takes effect immediately, without a new app version. Reset falls back to the standard colour.
clubSettings.labelsHint: What do you call your events? Empty means: standard wording.

firstSteps.title: First steps for {{club}}
firstSteps.footnote: That is all it takes – everything else can wait.

event.title: Create the first event
event.hint: So everyone knows when things happen

invite.title: Invite members
invite.hint: Share a link or QR code

news.title: Bring in news from your website

invite.title: Invitations
invite.listFootnote: Swipe left to revoke an invitation.
invite.scopeHint: A team invitation assigns the person to that team right away.
invite.adminWarning: Invited people receive full club rights and can change anything.
invite.limitsHint: Left empty, the invitation can be redeemed without limit.
invite.revokeConfirm: The invitation can no longer be redeemed. Members who already joined stay.
invite.shareHint: Anyone who opens the link becomes a member without further approval.
invite.qrFailed: The QR code could not be generated.
invite.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in lists and leaderboards.
invite.alreadyMember: You already belong to this club. Your role stays unchanged.
invite.invalidHint: Ask the club for a new invitation or send a join request.

invalid.exhausted: This invitation has already been fully used.

joinRequest.title: Join requests
joinRequest.decideHint: Without a different choice the person becomes a member.
joinRequest.rejectHint: The person gets a neutral message. No reason is stored.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: If you delete your account, your personal details disappear from every club you belong to. This cannot be undone.

removed.profile: Your display name and profile picture
removed.contact: Your contact details and sign-in account
removed.private: Your private notes and check-in answers

kept.points: Your point entries – with no link to you

deleteAccount.keptFootnote: They still count towards club statistics but carry no name. That way no past season’s leaderboard changes.
deleteAccount.blockedHint: In these clubs you are the only person with board rights. Appoint someone else first – or delete the club.
deleteAccount.confirmHint: We ask explicitly: type {{word}} in the field, because this cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.irreversible: You will be signed out afterwards.

members.title: Members
members.listFootnote: Tap a member to change role, status and teams.
members.teamsHint: A member can belong to several teams at once.
members.noTeams: The club has no teams yet
members.lastAdminHint: This person is the only board member. Appoint someone else before changing their role or status.

pointRules.title: Point rules
pointRules.label: Label
pointRules.codeHint: The code identifies the rule technically. It is unique per club and cannot be changed later.
pointRules.codeTaken: That code already exists in your club.
pointRules.thanksOnlyHint: A value of zero means “thanks only”: the contribution is acknowledged but shown without a number. A rule that is switched off produces nothing at all.
pointRules.forwardHint: Changes apply to new entries from now on. Points already awarded stay as they are.
pointRules.limitHint: Left empty the rule counts without limit. The limit is checked on the server.

eventForm.title: Create event
eventForm.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
eventForm.why: What is it for? Who does it help?
eventForm.whyHint: A call to action carries its purpose. Without it, it cannot be published.
eventForm.scopeHint: A team event appears only in that team’s agenda.
eventForm.ruleHint: The value of attending follows from this rule, not from an entry at check-in.
eventForm.seriesHint: A series creates all events at once and links them together.
eventForm.previewCapped: A series creates at most {{max}} events. Choose an earlier end date.

helperEvent.title: Publish a call for helpers
helperEvent.shiftsHint: Swipe left to remove a shift.
helperEvent.pointsHint: The suggestion follows the duration – half a day counts differently from a whole one. You can override it.
helperEvent.needsShift: A call for helpers needs at least one shift.
helperEvent.draftHint: A draft is invisible to members and notifies nobody.
helperEvent.mutedHint: Published – but without a push. No connecting message has gone out for over four weeks. Send a club pulse first.
helperEvent.needsWhy: Every call needs to say what it is for — otherwise it cannot be published.

newsImport.title: News from your website
newsImport.adminOnly: Only the board can connect the website.
newsImport.urlHint: If your website runs on WordPress we pull the latest posts into the feed – and the new ones every night. «ourclub.ch» is enough.
newsImport.disconnectConfirm: New posts from the website will no longer appear in the feed. Imported news stays.
newsImport.scheduleHint: The sync then runs automatically every night. Imported posts stay in the feed even after disconnecting.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.taken: You are signed up – points follow once the organisers confirm the shift.
shifts.released: Signed off. The spot is free again.
shifts.releasedWarned: Signed off. The organisers were told, because the shift is now short-staffed at short notice.
shifts.pointsHint: Each shift carries its own point value. It is credited once the organisers confirm the shift.
shifts.overlapMessage: You are already signed up for another shift at the same time. Take it anyway?

roster.title: Confirm shifts
roster.empty: Nobody is signed up for this shift
roster.hint: Confirm the people who actually turned up. The shift's points are credited as you do.
roster.alreadyAwarded: Already confirmed; nothing is credited a second time.
roster.addHint: For stand-ins: signed up and confirmed in one step.
roster.confirmedNoPoints: {{name}} confirmed – this shift awards no points.

checkIn.qrHint: Hold up the code so the people present can scan it. It is valid from 30 minutes before the start until the event ends.
checkIn.rosterEmpty: Nobody is expected at this event
checkIn.rosterHint: For anyone who cannot scan: record them here by hand.
checkIn.unmarked: The attendance mark is withdrawn. Points already credited stay.
checkIn.already: You were already checked in here. Nothing is credited twice.
checkIn.queued: No connection – your check-in is saved and will be sent once you are back online.

error.window: The code is only valid from 30 minutes before the start until the event ends.
error.wrongCode: This code belongs to a different event.
error.notMember: You are not a member of this club.
error.offline: No connection. Try again once you are back online.
error.generic: The check-in did not work. Please try again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for that.
error.camera: The camera cannot be opened. Check the camera permission for myclub.

checkIn.queueRejected_one: A saved check-in could no longer be booked – the window had closed.
checkIn.queueRejected_other: {{count}} saved check-ins could no longer be booked – the window had closed.

reminder.title: Remind those who haven't answered
reminder.confirm_one: One person has not answered yet. They will get a reminder with a way to answer straight away.
reminder.confirm_other: {{count}} people have not answered yet. They will get a reminder with a way to answer straight away.
reminder.tooSoon: A reminder for this event was already sent on {{when}}. At most once a day.
reminder.noneLeft: Nobody is left to remind – everyone has answered.

inbox.title: Messages
inbox.hint: Every notification appears here, push or not. Tapping opens what it refers to and marks it as read.
